name: Citicoline
summary: Citicoline is a nootropic substance belonging to the Ammonium salt chemical class.

pharmacology.text: Citicoline may enhance cellular communication by increasing levels of neurotransmitters. The choline component of citicoline is used to create acetylcholine, which is a neurotransmitter in the human brain. Clinical trials have found that citicoline supplementation might improve focus and attention.

uses.text: It is readily available and commonly sold for this purpose through the use of online supplement vendors.

sideEffects.text: Citicoline has a very low toxicity profile in animals and humans.

fact.en: Citicoline, also called CDP-choline, is made naturally in every cell. Its role in building cell membranes was worked out in 1956 by the biochemist Eugene Kennedy, and the pathway now carries his name.
fact.zh: 胞磷膽鹼又稱 CDP-膽鹼，每個細胞都會自然製造。它在建構細胞膜中的角色，是生化學家尤金·甘迺迪在 1956 年解開的，這條代謝途徑如今也以他命名。
fact.zhHans: 胞磷胆碱又称 CDP-胆碱，每个细胞都会自然制造。它在建构细胞膜中的角色，是生化学家尤金·甘迺迪在 1956 年解开的，这条代谢途径如今也以他命名。
